subject: Index resilience plan: backfill orchestration, vector-store checks, and rerank acceptance
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Subject: Index resilience plan: backfill orchestration, vector-store checks, and rerank acceptance

Samir — thanks for the time today. Per our call here is a concise operational plan for Northwave's embeddings -> rerank migration with a focus on index resilience and measurable acceptance criteria. Attaching the runbook, index schema, and a small rerank sample set.

High-level schedule
- March 8: staging backfill (1% of corpus) + smoke rerank evaluation
- March 15–17: incremental parallel backfill (30% -> 70%) with progressive throttling
- March 22: cutover window (low-traffic) and verification; rollback target 2 hours

Backfill orchestration notes
- Parallelism: backfill will operate per-shard (recommended concurrency 8 workers per shard); we will cap throughput to 300 qps per shard to avoid hotspotting the DB cluster.
- Checkpoints: every 50k documents commit index snapshot and KV checkpoint to S3 to allow resume-from-checkpoint.
- Resilience: if a node fails, orchestrator reassigns shard work with exponential backoff; we will keep 10% headroom in shard capacity for retries.

Vector DB considerations (Vectorsmith managed cluster)
- Dimensionality: confirm embeddings are 1536-d (we expect 1536 in the attached schema). If Northwave uses 1024-d, we will adjust the rerank head to avoid vector transform drift.
- Quantization: Vectorsmith supports int8 and fp16; for production we recommend fp16 for high-recall queries with rerank. If memory becomes a constraint we can evaluate int8 on a shadow index.
- Consistency checks: pre-cutover we will run 1000 canonical queries vs legacy index and compare top-10 overlap >= 85% before allowing final cutover.

Rerank evals and acceptance metrics
- Sample set: use attached rerank-eval-samples.csv (150 queries).
- Pass criteria: NDCG@10 improvement >= 8% over legacy ranker OR precision@3 within +/-2% while reducing average latency <= 120ms p95.
- Regression guardrails: any drop >5% in relevance triggers immediate rollback.

Action items for this thread
- Samir: confirm staging window March 8, and whether you want fp16 or int8 shadow tests.
- Ben: prepare backfill job definitions and the shard concurrency config in the runbook.
- Marissa: draft the rerank smoke test harness and create the acceptance dashboard (token breakdown + relevance metrics).

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks Hannah — plan looks solid. A few clarifications from our side: 
- March 8 staging window works. We'll put the customer-facing search cluster into maintenance 09:00–12:00 PDT so you get a quiet window.
- We currently generate 1536-d embeddings, so that matches.
- For quantization: let's run fp16 in staging and run an int8 shadow for cost comparison; don't cut over int8 without explicit perf/relevance sign-off.

Two questions:
1) Can you confirm expected backfill throughput so we can provision EBS/IOPS on our Vectorsmith cluster?
2) For the canonical 1000 queries — can we include 200 that are low-frequency tail queries? We want to make sure tail recall isn't silently degraded.

Samir

(Internal technical follow-up)
Quoting Samir's note about throughput and tail queries — actionable items I'm picking up: 
- Backfill throughput guidance: aim for sustained 250–350 doc/s per worker depending on embedding cost. For the Vectorsmith managed cluster we should size to ~6k IOPS baseline; I'll write an exact IOPS table into the runbook.
- Tail queries: yes — include 200 low-frequency queries in the 1k canonical set; we'll stratify sample by frequency deciles so tail coverage is explicit.

Implementation checklist I'm adding to the runbook (short form):
- [ ] Backfill job templates (shard concurrency, checkpoint cadence, retry policy) — Ben
- [ ] Shadow int8 build and compare job (A/B store) — Ben
- [ ] Rerank harness + NDCG/P@k scripts + dashboard hooks — Marissa
- [ ] Cutover playbook (preflight, cutover, smoke checks, rollback steps) — Hannah
- [ ] DB sanity scripts (topk overlap, vector norm distribution, embedding drift detector) — Ben

Ben: schedule a 60-min runbook review tomorrow at 11am PT with Samir if that works — want to lock the IOPS and worker sizing before March 8.

-Marissa
